text.tspan: Share of students achieving minimum math proficiency by the end of
Minimum math proficiency for the end of lower-secondary education means students demonstrate skills in computation,
application problems, matching tables and graphs, and making use of algebraic representations.

tspan.tspan: UNESCO Institute for Statistics; World Bank (2026)
This data omits children who don't attend school. Learning outcomes over time should be interpreted with caution. Where data for 2023

text.tspan: is unavailable, the value from the closest year between 2013 and 2022 is shown instead.
